prompts.name: Assertive Text
prompts.summary: You are a professional writing assistant.

prompts.name: Business Tone (General)
prompts.summary: Transform the text to use a professional, business-appropriate tone.

prompts.name: De-Imposter Syndrome
prompts.summary: Take the text provided by the user and edit it with the following context in mind: the user suffers from 'imposter syndrome' and tends to downplay or understate their capabilities, knowledge, and achievements.

prompts.name: Emotionally Sensitive
prompts.summary: Adjust the tone of the input text to be more emotionally aware and sensitive while maintaining professionalism.

prompts.name: Firm But Polite (Boundary Setting)
prompts.summary: Take the text provided by the user.

prompts.name: Formal Tone (General)
prompts.summary: Transform the text to use a highly formal tone suitable for official communications.

prompts.name: Great News!
prompts.summary: Take the text provided by the user, assuming the context that it is intended as the draft of a professional email.

prompts.name: Impress The Boss
prompts.summary: Take the text provided by the user and edit it with the following task and context in mind: the text is an email or message from the user to a boss or colleagues.

prompts.name: Journalistic Style
prompts.summary: Transform the text into a journalistic article format with the following elements: - A clear, attention-grabbing headline - A concise lead paragraph summarizing the key information (who, what, when, where, why, how)...

prompts.name: Literary And Formal
prompts.summary: Take the text provided by the user and edit it according to the following instructions: preface the user's text with the city they are writing from and today's date.

prompts.name: Maximise Formality
prompts.summary: Your task is to take the user’s text and transform it into an exceptionally formal correspondence.
